:::{#thm-loghaz-decomp}
#### Decomposition of log-hazard
$$
\ba
\loghaz(t|\vx) = \loghaz_0(t) + \diffloghaz(t|\vx)
\ea
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

$$
\ba
\loghaz(t|\vx)
&= \loghaz(t|\vzero) + \loghaz(t|\vx) - \loghaz(t|\vzero) && \text{(adding and subtracting } \loghaz(t|\vzero)\text{)} \\
&\eqdef \loghaz_0(t) + \loghaz(t|\vx) - \loghaz(t|\vzero) && \text{(definition of baseline log-hazard)} \\
&\eqdef \loghaz_0(t) + \diffloghaz(t|\vx : \vzero) && \text{(definition of difference in log-hazards)} \\
&\eqdef \loghaz_0(t) + \diffloghaz(t|\vx) && \text{(definition of difference in log-hazard from baseline)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-decomposition-of-log-hazard-1}

:::
